departments.name: Frontier & Gap Discovery
departments.charter: Maps the field the owner names, finds gaps that are still open, and ranks them by impact, tractability and how verifiable a result would be. Every citation verified.

departments.name: Theory & Proofs
departments.charter: Formal statements, proof and derivation attempts, computational checks and Lean formalisation. Proven, conjectured and open are always labelled as such.

departments.name: Experiments
departments.charter: Reproduces the strongest baselines first, then runs the new method with fixed seeds and logged configs, sized to the owner's machine. Never reports a result that was not run.

departments.name: Writing & Submission
departments.charter: Venue-ready manuscripts (or an honest technical report when a result is not verified), every claim mapped to a checked result, with a submission checklist.

departments.name: Outreach
departments.charter: Drafts to collaborators, experts for feedback, prize committees and venues. Drafts only; the owner sends.

departments.name: Ethics & Integrity
departments.charter: Authorship and AI-use disclosure under the venue's rules, prize and competition rules, data licences, dual-use risk.
